stem:
【阅读理解B·记叙文】
When I was ten, my grandfather gave me a small wooden boat he had carved by hand. "Every great journey starts with a single push," he told me, smiling. I kept the boat on my desk for years and, although I never sailed it, it always reminded me of him. After he passed away, I finally placed the boat on a shelf where I could see it every day. Now, whenever I face a difficult choice, I remember his words and find the courage to move forward.

B. He used it as a pencil holder.

D. It was a gift from his friend.

options: A. He was a sailor by profession.

stem:
【阅读理解C·说明文】
The Amazon rainforest, often called "the lungs of the Earth", produces roughly 6 percent of the world's oxygen and stores huge amounts of carbon. However, in recent decades, large areas have been cleared for farming and cattle raising. Scientists warn that if the current rate of deforestation continues, the rainforest could turn into a dry savanna by the end of this century, which would release enormous amounts of carbon dioxide and speed up global warming.
问题：What is the main idea of the passage? A. Why the Amazon is called "the lungs of the Earth". B. How oxygen is produced in the forest. C. The danger the Amazon rainforest is facing. D. How to plant trees in the rainforest.
options: A. Why the Amazon is called "the lungs of the Earth".
B. How oxygen is produced in the forest.
C. The danger the Amazon rainforest is facing.
D. How to plant trees in the rainforest.

options: A. The rainforest will become larger.
B. More oxygen will be produced.

D. Global temperatures will drop sharply.

writing_prompt:
【读后续写】阅读下面短文，根据其内容和你对它的理解，用英文续写两段（每段约 75 词，共约 150 词）。
The Gift
It was a cold December afternoon. Tom, a 12-year-old boy, was walking home from school when he noticed an old man sitting on the sidewalk, shivering in the thin coat. Tom stopped and looked at him for a while. He had only five dollars in his pocket, which he had saved for weeks to buy his mother a birthday present. He hesitated for a moment, but then walked up to the old man and said, "Sir, please take this." The old man raised his head, surprised, with a warm smile on his face...
Paragraph 1: The old man took the money with great gratitude and told Tom his story.
Paragraph 2: When Tom arrived home and told his mother what he had done, she had a special reaction.

writing_prompt:
【读后续写】阅读下面短文，根据其内容和你对它的理解，用英文续写两段（每段约 75 词，共约 150 词）。
The Last Race
Lin was a member of the school running team. Although he was not the fastest runner, he never gave up training. Before the final race of the city sports meet, Lin caught a bad cold and his coach told him to give up. However, Lin insisted on taking part, because it was his last chance to run for his school. On the day of the race, he stood at the starting line, his hands shaking...
Paragraph 1: The race began, and something unexpected happened to Lin during the race.
Paragraph 2: Although the result was not what he had hoped for, Lin learned something important from the race.

writing_prompt:
【概要写作】阅读下面短文，写一篇 60 词左右的内容概要。
In recent years, online learning has become popular among students around the world. It allows students to study at their own pace and choose courses that interest them. However, online learning also has some disadvantages. For example, students may feel lonely without face-to-face communication with teachers and classmates. Besides, they need strong self-control to avoid being distracted by computers and phones. Therefore, both online and traditional classroom learning have their own strengths. Many experts suggest combining the two methods to get the best learning results.

writing_prompt:
【概要写作】阅读下面短文，写一篇 60 词左右的内容概要。
Volunteering is a meaningful way for high school students to spend their free time. By helping others, students can learn important life skills such as communication, teamwork and problem-solving. Volunteering also gives students a chance to understand different people and cultures. However, some students worry that volunteering takes up too much time and may affect their studies. In fact, studies have shown that students who volunteer regularly usually do better at school because they become more confident and responsible. So schools should encourage more students to take part in volunteer activities.
